landing-how-it-works-subtitle: From empty workspace to a team moving work across the board in minutes.
landing-step-1-desc: Spin up a home for your team or project so boards and members stay in one place.
landing-step-2-desc: Create Kanban boards for streams of work—each with its own columns and flow.
landing-step-3-desc: Break work into cards, move them across statuses, and keep context where the work lives.
landing-step-4-desc: Bring teammates in with the right access so everyone stays aligned.
landing-faq-subtitle: Quick answers before you dive in.
landing-faq-a1: Zennety is a collaborative Kanban app: workspaces, boards, cards, and invites so your team can plan and ship work in one flow.
landing-faq-q2: Do I need to install anything?
landing-faq-a2: No. Zennety runs in your browser—sign up and start from any device with a modern browser.
landing-faq-q3: How do workspaces and boards relate?
landing-faq-a3: A workspace groups people and boards. Boards hold columns and cards, so you can separate products, teams, or projects while staying under one roof.
landing-faq-a4: Yes. Invite members to a workspace or board so everyone sees the same boards and cards.
landing-faq-a5: The project is on GitHub—you can review the code, star the repo, and follow updates there.
landing-cta-subtitle: Create an account or sign in and open your first workspace in a few clicks.
landing-seo-description: Zennety helps teams collaborate with workspaces, Kanban boards, and cards. Sign up to plan work, invite members, and ship faster—all in one place.
